{{Quote|Use the gas bombs!|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], giving the order to kill the Zillo Beast|<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>}}
'''Gas bombs''' were a type of ordnance that carried [[Poison/Legends|poison]] gas. These [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] were used to [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|kill]] the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] that rampaged across [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The poison had been developed from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastarian]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]] specifically to kill the Zillo Beast. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] personally gave the order to use the bombs against the beast.
